children: China is expected to invest $940 billion in energy in 2026, the most of any country, according to the Global Energy Transition Report 2026, Bloomberg reported, citing China Central Television, which reported the forecast Sunday. The report was released by the China Enterprise Reform and Development Society.

title: CCTV: China Forecast to Lead Global Energy Investment in 2026
